question: Which great Māyā embodying the syllable phaṭ always protects in the north?
premises: The goddess embodies the syllable phaṭ.
Continual protection is sought in the north.
inference: Mahāmāyā, embodying phaṭ, continually guards in the north.
plain_english: May Mahāmāyā, whose form is phaṭ, always protect me in the north.
